mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 40% of tightening cycles with FEDFUNDS above 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising PAYEMS (indicating a strong labor market) and low UNRATE (below 5.0%) creates a 'goldilocks' zone, where the S&P 500 experiences positive forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to increased consumer spending.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 30% of 'goldilocks' zone instances.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in INDPRO, signaling reduced industrial production, precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as supply chain disruptions impact corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of quarters with declining INDPRO.

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST (housing starts) increases by more than 10% in a month, indicating a surge in demand for new housing, the S&P 500 experiences positive forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to the ripple effect on related industries.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of months with > 10% HOUST increase.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of low FEDFUNDS (below 1.0%) and high RSAFS (above $400 billion) indicates an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors seek higher yields.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 45% of instances with accommodative monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in UNRATE by more than 0.5% in a month, signaling labor market stress, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors reassess economic growth prospects.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of months with > 0.5% UNRATE increase.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding a 3-month average of 250, indicating high inflation, erodes consumer purchasing power, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced demand.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of periods with high CPIAUCSL.
